randomSpawnRule.countMeaning: numberRandom caps total entities, not number of groups
randomSpawnRule.runtimeNote: H5 uses an independent deterministic seed; native RNG state and cross-event queued-position rejection are not reproduced

spawnPointsContract: One row per tile point per mission, BEFORE interval repeats. position uses cameraTop=orthographicSize; origin and rotation are original. For another cameraTop recompute z=origin.z+abs(layoutMinZ-cameraTop)+1 only if needsCameraTopTranslation.

camera.status: chapter cameraId 3 resolves Model_model id 3 BattleCameraFollow; prefab projection confirmed, runtime bounds overrides not fully traced

collision.entityScale: Initial SetTableData builds raw Shape; ScalePercent% defaults to 100. RefreshShapeScale uses attribute-derived scale. ModelScale is not merged into attributes or initial shape.
collision.bulletShapeTwoValues: ordinary bullet uses box half extents; special BulletType3 branches separately

positionPlacement.sourceCoordinates: MapMonsterItem FPVector3; mission Monster[] can override entityId
positionPlacement.zTranslation: bornType==1: raw z; otherwise raw z + abs(layoutMinZ - cameraTop) + 1

combinedSpawnRule: Concatenate spawnPoints for missionId AND randomSpawns[eventId]; they are additive, not alternatives.
